newsitem.title: USA: IDEXX Laboratories loses more than half its market value.
newsitem.headline: IDEXX Laboratories loses more than half its market value.

text.p: IDEXX Laboratories Corp. lost more than half its market value Monday after it said its first-quarter financial results would be well below Wall Street expectations.
IDEXX's stock plummeted $17.875 to $14.125 in very heavy early trading on the Nasdaq market, where it was one of the most actively traded issues.

The biotechnology company, which is based Westbrook, Maine, said earlier that it expected first-quarter earnings of between 2 cents and 5 cents a share -- well below Wall Street analysts' consensus expectation of 22 cents a share, according to Zack's Investment Research.

IDEXX said in a statement that the lower earnings were due to lower-than-anticipated sales of certain veterinary diagnostic products and a decision to decrease distributor shipments in the first and second quarters.
